changelog: NEW Live Enigma2 Image Browser on TV: Click any image (OpenPLi 9.2, OpenATV 8.0, OpenBH 6.0, EGAMI 11.0, OpenViX 6.9, OpenSPA, PurE2 7.6, OpenHDF 7.5, OpenDroid 8.1.2) to browse ALL supported receivers & download the latest .zip directly!
Fixed ALL plugin, skin & softcam versions & live links (Fury-FHD v9.0, OSCam 11950, NCam 15.7, AJPanel 10.8.5, KeyAdder 9.6, RaedQuickSignal 19.0 & more)
Added Live Auto-Version Detector on TV: Always fetches the latest real version directly from official developer repos
Full Vu+ & Novaler receiver auto-detection + Ready-to-share .ipk & .deb packages

plugins.name: EGAMI Image (11.0 Live — Select Box)
plugins.description: EGAMI Image (11.0 Live — Select Box) by ElieSat (إيلي سات) — Auto-updated directly from official developer source.
plugins.cmd_opkg: BOX=$(cat /proc/stb/info/boxtype 2>/dev/null || cat /proc/stb/info/model 2>/dev/null || hostname); DIR=/media/hdd/images; [ -d /media/hdd ] || DIR=/media/usb/images; [ -d /media/usb ] || [ -d /media/hdd ] || DIR=/tmp/images; mkdir -p $DIR; echo "[mizou1984] EGAMI Image Fetcher | Box: $BOX | Save: $DIR"; FILE=$(wget -qO- --no-check-certificate https://image.egami-image.com/index.php?open=$BOX | grep -oE "egami-[0-9A-Za-z._-]+\.zip" | head -n 1); if [ -n "$FILE" ]; then echo "[mizou1984] Downloading $FILE ..."; wget --no-check-certificate -O "$DIR/$FILE" "https://image.egami-image.com/$BOX/$FILE" && echo "[mizou1984] Saved to $DIR/$FILE — Flash via Image Manager / Flash Online!"; else echo "[mizou1984] Box $BOX: Visit https://egami-image.com or install Image Downloader plugin from this Images menu."; fi
plugins.cmd_dpkg: echo "[mizou1984] EGAMI Official Portal: https://egami-image.com — Install Image Downloader plugin from this menu for online flashing."
